<title level="1" pfs="">[Sky Fisher](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3310)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

The sky fisher is an unusual aerial predator, mostly found in tropical jungle regions but occasionally seen as far north as Varisia. Naturalists believe it's a distant relative of the jellyfish that has evolved into a new ecological niche through prolonged exposure to elemental energies from the [Plane of Air](/Planes.aspx?ID=29). That the biggest, most aggressive sky fishers are found (and thought to have originated) near powerful loci of elemental air, such as in Garund's Terwa Uplands or around the Eye of Abendego, lends further credence to this theory.

 In appearance, a sky fisher resembles an enormous jellyfish, its many dangling tendrils hanging beneath a clear bulbous body. Although its appearance is quite difficult to accurately determine, as its natural transparent form is almost completely invisible, its inside contain a complex chemical factory that produces lighter-than-air gases, paralyzing toxins, and flesh-eating enzymes. These enzymes are highly potent and often desired by toxicologists due to their unique properties. The creature hunts by hovering just above the forest canopy, using eye-like clusters on the ends of its tentacles as a kind of inverted periscope. When it spots prey, it floats close and waits for an opportune moment to sting. Then, as paralysis takes hold, the sky fisher hoists its meal into the sky to slowly consume it. Inside, enzymes break down the dead or paralyzed victims into a bloody slurry.

 A recently fed sky fisher can always be quickly identified by the looping coils of blood that circulate through its body—a beautiful, if terrible, sight.

<title level="2" right="Creature 11">[Sky Fisher](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3310)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 181

**Perception** +18; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +21, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +21, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +23

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +5

**Dex** +7

**Con** +7

**Int** -4

**Wis** +0

**Cha** -3
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 30 

**Fort** +22 

**Ref** +22 

**Will** +15 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 200

</row>

**Immunities**
precision

**Resistances**
bludgeoning 14, [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) 14

**Weaknesses**
piercing 7, slashing 7

**Transparency** Unless it has fed recently, the sky fisher is naturally [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83). Using non-[hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) does not cause the sky fisher to become [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=79). When it takes a hostile action of any kind, the sky fisher is hidden instead of [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) until the start of its next turn, as the vague outline of its many tendrils temporarily becomes faintly visible.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** fly 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
stinging tentacle +24 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [reach 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 2d8+8 bludgeoning plus sky fisher venom and [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Abduct** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15)) The sky fisher reels in a target grabbed by its tentacles, pulling them into an adjacent space, and then attempts to [Swallow them Whole](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=77) (Large, 3d8+12 acid, Rupture 25). The sky fisher can only use Swallow Whole when using Abduct.

**Enzymic Vent** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) The sky fisher vents flesh-eating enzymes into the air, dealing 3d6 [persistent acid damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and 3d6 persistent bleed damage in a 20-foot emanation (DC 25 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). It can't use Enzymic Vent again for 1d4 rounds.

**Jet** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Move](/Traits.aspx?ID=114)) The sky fisher quickly expels some of its gases to move swiftly through the air, [Flying](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) up to 100 feet in a straight line; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.

**Sky Fisher Venom**  ([Poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126)) **Saving Throw** DC 25 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 3d6 poison damage, [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), and can't speak above a whisper (1 round); **Stage 2** 3d8 poison damage, clumsy 2, and can't speak (1 round); **Stage 3** 3d10 poison damage and [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85) (1 round)

</column>
